_README: This file is managed by LazyCue (see shelley/lazycue). Do NOT edit by hand — it is the cached, machine-generated DSL for a self-healing browser test. To change behavior, edit the test description and re-run LazyCue.
description: Project folds survive reloads and renames; a deleted project's goes. The server runs in workspace mode, with the projects "Busy tasks" (id {{BUSY_ID}}), which has a task, and "Empty tasks" (id {{EMPTY_ID}}), right after it, which is empty. Call "order" returns the server's project names, in order, JSON-encoded; call "rename and delete" renames "Busy tasks" to "Renamed tasks" and deletes "Empty tasks". "The toggle of" P is "section[aria-label=\"P\"] .project-toggle". On a fresh server the first load of a page takes a few seconds while the Assistant is created (the header title reads "Shelley" until then): wait for elements rather than reading the page right after navigating. On a phone-sized screen the drawer is off-canvas until the header's "Open tasks" button is clicked. To "open the drawer": click the button named exactly "Open tasks" if it is visible (on a phone it is whenever the drawer is closed: it is the header's top-left button; the drawer's own "Close tasks" button stays in the page while the drawer is off-canvas, so it says nothing about whether the drawer is open); the element with data-testid "assistant-row" should then be visible within the viewport. To "reload": the reload action. To "open the settings of" a project P: click "section[aria-label=\"P\"] a.project-select", then, in the element with data-testid "project-view", click the button named exactly "Settings" in its navigation (its <nav> element; click it even when its tab already shows); "the editor" is the region (role "region"; a <section> with that aria-label) named exactly "Edit project". To "edit project P" with a change: eval sessionStorage.setItem("editFrom", location.pathname) to remember the page; open the drawer; open the settings of P; make the change in the editor; click the editor's button named exactly "Save project"; the editor's text "Saved." should be visible; then return to the remembered page with a full load: eval (() => { window.__leaving = 1; location.assign(sessionStorage.getItem("editFrom")); return "leaving"; })(), expecting "leaving", then eval "window.__leaving === undefined && document.readyState === 'complete'" until it returns true. Perform the steps in order. 1. Navigate to /. 2. Open the drawer. 3. The toggle of "Busy tasks" should have aria-expanded "true", and that of "Empty tasks" aria-expanded "false". 4. Click the toggle of "Busy tasks", then the toggle of "Empty tasks". 5. The toggle of "Busy tasks" should come to have aria-expanded "false", and that of "Empty tasks" aria-expanded "true". 6. Reload. 7. Open the drawer. 8. The toggle of "Busy tasks" should have aria-expanded "false", and that of "Empty tasks" aria-expanded "true". 9. Open the settings of "Empty tasks". 10. Click the editor's button named exactly "Move up" (Move up swaps a project with the one before it, for every list of projects). 11. Call "order" until it returns exactly {{AFTER}}. 12. Eval this until it returns true: the aria-labels of the "section.project-group" elements, in document order, kept only if "Busy tasks" or "Empty tasks", are exactly ["Empty tasks", "Busy tasks"]. 13. Call "rename and delete" (folds follow the project's id, not its name). 14. Reload. 15. Open the drawer. 16. The toggle of "Renamed tasks" should have aria-expanded "false". 17. There must be exactly 0 toggles of "Empty tasks". 18. Eval this; it must return true: (() => { const stored = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem("shelley-project-folds") ?? "{}"); return stored["project:{{BUSY_ID}}"] === true && !("project:{{EMPTY_ID}}" in stored); })().

steps.expression: (() => { const stored = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('shelley-project-folds') ?? '{}'); return stored['project:{{BUSY_ID}}'] === true && !('project:{{EMPTY_ID}}' in stored); })()
